title: TCCounts: enumerating the specification space of western North Pacific and Philippine Area of Responsibility tropical cyclone count trends
description: Scripts and derived data behind an enumeration of every defensible specification of a tropical cyclone count trend in the western North Pacific basin and the PAGASA Philippine Area of Responsibility, 1884 to 2023. Clips IBTrACS v04r01 to the PAR hexagon, fits and tests a linear trend under all 2,400 combinations of six grading requirements, four counting rules and fifty start years, measures the size and power of the significance test by simulation, and reproduces every value reported in the accompanying manuscript through an automated check suite.
